overview.description: Custom shower tile installation including waterproofing, mortar bed, wall and floor tile, niches, benches, and curbless entries. Covers walk-in showers, tub surrounds, and steam showers.

materials.name: Large Format Porcelain (12x24, 24x48)
materials.durability: Excellent — less than 0.5% water absorption, impervious per ASTM standards
materials.maintenanceLevel: Low — fewer grout lines to maintain

materials.name: Ceramic Subway Tile (3x6, 4x12)
materials.durability: Good — suitable for shower walls with proper waterproofing behind

materials.name: Marble (Carrara, Calacatta, Statuario)
materials.durability: Good with sealing — porous, susceptible to etching from acidic products
materials.maintenanceLevel: High — requires sealing before grouting and annually thereafter

materials.name: Marble-Look Porcelain
materials.durability: Excellent — marble aesthetic with porcelain water resistance
bestFor: homeowners wanting marble look without maintenance

materials.name: Glass Mosaic (1x1, 2x2 sheets)
materials.durability: Excellent water resistance — near-zero absorption, fragile on impact
materials.maintenanceLevel: Low — use unsanded grout and white thin-set only

materials.name: Penny Tile / Hex Mosaic (porcelain)
materials.durability: Excellent — mesh-mounted sheets for curved surfaces
materials.maintenanceLevel: Medium — many grout joints require more maintenance

materials.name: Zellige / Handmade-Look Tile
materials.durability: Good — glaze variations are intentional, adds character

techniques.name: Schluter KERDI Waterproofing System
techniques.description: Pliable polyethylene membrane bonded to substrate with thin-set. Industry standard for custom showers. Requires 2-inch overlaps at seams. Integrates with KERDI-DRAIN, KERDI-BOARD, and KERDI-BAND.

techniques.name: Wedi Board System
techniques.description: Foam-core, glass-fiber-reinforced panels that are inherently waterproof. No separate membrane needed. Excellent for shower walls, niches, and benches.

techniques.name: Laticrete Hydro Ban Liquid Membrane
techniques.description: Thin liquid-applied waterproofing membrane that cures to a flexible, crack-bridging layer. Ideal for complex geometries where sheet membranes are difficult to apply.

techniques.name: Mortar Bed Shower Pan
techniques.description: Traditional mud-set shower floor with 1/4 inch per foot slope toward drain. Provides custom slope and shape. Used with KERDI-DRAIN or PVC liner system.

techniques.name: Curbless / Zero-Entry Shower Build
techniques.description: Linear drain with continuous slope from bathroom floor into shower. Requires precise leveling, linear drain system, and waterproofing across the transition. ADA-compliant.

techniques.name: Niche and Bench Construction
techniques.description: Recessed niches and bench seats built with waterproof foam board (KERDI-BOARD or Wedi). Must slope niche sill outward to drain water. Pre-formed niche kits available.

patterns.name: Subway / Running Bond
patterns.description: Classic offset brick pattern. Timeless, works in any shower from traditional to modern. 3x6, 4x8, or 4x12 formats.

patterns.name: Stacked / Straight Lay
patterns.description: Tiles aligned in a perfect grid with aligned joints. Clean modern look, requires perfectly flat substrate.

patterns.name: Herringbone
patterns.description: V-shaped zigzag pattern. Adds visual interest and movement. Uses more material (10-15% waste factor).

patterns.name: Vertical Stack
patterns.description: Subway tiles laid vertically instead of horizontally. Creates height illusion, modern aesthetic.

patterns.name: Chevron
patterns.description: Arrow-shaped tiles that form a V pattern. More complex than herringbone, requires mitered tile cuts.

climateConsiderations: Freeze-thaw cycles in exterior walls can stress shower waterproofing at exterior-facing showers
Cold winters drive demand for heated shower floors (Schluter DITRA-HEAT)
Humidity swings between seasons stress grout joints — flexible grout recommended at change-of-plane
Older Boston homes often have non-standard framing requiring custom waterproofing solutions
